newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol invests 67 bln pta in propylene oxide plant.
newsitem.headline: Repsol invests 67 bln pta in propylene oxide plant.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol has agreed a 67.0 billion peseta ($432.7 million) investment in a propylene oxide and styrene plant in Catalonia, due to come on stream in the first half of 1999, a statement from the firm said on Tuesday.
In an annoucement made in April, Repsol said the Tarragona plant would require an outlay of 60.0 billion pesetas.

The new plant will increase the firm's proplyene oxide capacity to 210,000 tonnes from 60,000 tonnes per year. Styrene capacity will be raised to 475,000 tonnes per year from 135,000 tonnnes, Repsol said.
The investment was approved by Repsol's board on Monday.
Work on the plant will begin in August.
